domIntegration.limits: Node happy-dom simulation of actual root wiring and actual UI/climate/storage/timer modules. Scene, pet and audio engine are boundary spies; no browser rendering, native focus trap, autoplay policy or audible output asserted.

performance.scope: Native CPU Skia rendering benchmark; not a Chrome or whole-page FPS claim
performance.methodology: Matched 1672×941 decoded autumn/rain/night plate and real objects, seeded rain, monitor completed and both lamps ON. 600 50-ms RAF callbacks warm the simulation to 30 s and all 76 physical drops; compare next 180 rendered frames. RAF timestamps are input to adaptive pressure only; measurements are actual native Canvas draw + 1 px readback wall time. A separate 1800-callback 60 Hz run followed by 50-ms callbacks checks the normal-to-sustained-pressure transition. No GUI or browser debugging automation used.
limitations: CPU Skia differs from Chrome GPU compositing and the complete DOM/pet workload.
Injected RAF intervals do not measure browser FPS.
The one scheduled rare boat wake is deliberately not fired in matched rain workload.
Exploratory trial 1 artifacts are excluded because they did not track global timers and predate final reflection spread.

review.fixed: Keyboard focus moves to the next visible focus-timer control after each user action.

boatRendering.label: Native Skia renderer artifact, not a browser screenshot or GUI fallback
boatRendering.method: Actual mountPenthouseEffects and RiverBoat draw path, real autumn/noon and night plates; decoded real objects, deterministic boat direction and manually triggered actual scheduled wake; 60 Hz delivered RAF timestamps. Compositor glass/monitor masks remain intact. DOM overlays, Milky and clock/calendar HTML are outside this Canvas-only render.
boatRendering.inspected: Root viewed actual noon and night river crops; small matte hull fits the painted water. Worker verified mullion and monitor occlusion. Not browser evidence.
